title: Founding of NASA's electrostatics lab by Carlos Gier

tellings.quote: it was founded about 26 years ago by Dr. Carlos Gier, a physicist who uh spent a summer working at Kennedy Space Center.

plain: A NASA scientist named Charles Buhler says NASA's electrostatics lab at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, which studies static electric charge, was founded around 2000, "about 26 years ago," by Dr. Carlos Gier, "a physicist who spent a summer working at Kennedy Space Center." Buhler tells Michels this as someone who worked there, in an episode where he claims his group has built a propulsion system that works without pushing anything out.
